description:
Prevent silent cross-provider session resumes (adversarial finding #4). A Codex thread-id and an agy conversation-id share the sessions/reviews tables with no way to tell them apart; resuming one under the wrong backend fails confusingly (Gemini UUID → resumeThread failure; Codex thread-id → ConversationStore/agy miss).

- Tag sessions with their provider: either add a `provider` column to the sessions table (src/storage/sessions.ts) or namespace the id (e.g. `gemini:<uuid>` / `codex:<threadid>`). Prefer the column (keeps ids clean) unless namespacing is simpler end-to-end.
- On resume, if the stored provider ≠ the active backend, return a clear, specific error (not opaque SESSION_NOT_FOUND) — or route to the correct backend if/when that's supported.
- review_history surfaces the provider per entry.

Keep storage backend-agnostic (no SDK imports; provider is just a TEXT tag). Acceptance: resuming a gemini session under codex (and vice-versa) yields a clear correct error; history shows provider per review.
title: Provider provenance on sessions
